parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The universally unique identifier (UUID) of the event.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is deployed. You must select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are deployed in the Chinese mainland or in the China (Hong Kong) region.

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are deployed in regions outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the member. This parameter is used in a multi-account management scenario. An administrator can specify this parameter to query the data of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator account.
